motivation: Full-parameter adaptation shows validation overfitting on the small language corpus. No final-test assessment has started.
targets: query and value matrices of all five decoder layers and the vocabulary output matrix
selection: Minimum technical validation cross entropy at the fixed development endpoint; each main source arm separately selects its minimum validation-loss checkpoint including the incoming base.
test_policy: Evaluate every selected full-parameter and constrained source-arm checkpoint on the same untouched test documents; compare with base 5 using paired document resampling.
inference: Rank updates merged into the existing native weights with a measured floating-point agreement check at every selected export.
